ai_cloud_enabled.description: Kill switch: false stops every cloud AI call (on-device AI and keywords keep working).

ai_cloud_model.description: Cloud Gemini model used for fallback and escalation.

ai_escalate_below.description: Hybrid mode: when Gemini Nano's confidence is below this, the snapshot is re-checked in the cloud.

ai_prompt_extra.description: Extra guidance appended to the classification prompt (for example a new scam pattern).
